channel.title: Bloombot news
channel.description: Updates and announcements from Bloombot, the Garden Tower Defense trading bot.

item.title: New: unit pages, your collection and price alerts
item.description: Every unit gets its own page, track what your units are worth, get a DM when a price moves, make real offers in chats, and upvote the best strategies.

item.title: Message other traders on the website
item.description: Private chats right on Bloombot, with pictures, emojis and a chat filter. Plus a farm calculator for Seeds and Fertilizer per hour.

item.title: Website update: levels, crate calculator, profiles and more
item.description: Levels with one-time XP tasks, an in-game style crate calculator, profile popups, Google login, Roblox verify, a server dashboard and a light mode.

item.title: The Bloombot website is here!
item.description: Everything Bloombot does in Discord, now in your browser too. Values, a trade calculator, trade ads and strategies, with one-click Discord login.
